The '''LpL computer''' was a [[Flight computer/Legends|flight computer]] manufactured by [[Microaxial/Legends|Microaxial]]. They were installed on [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]].<ref name="SWS" />
